hatConclusion: Do not use a universal motif axis for vanilla hats. Treat hats primarily as construction/component families; small front marks may exist, but the audit does not support generic motif transfer as a default.
shirtConclusion: Vanilla shirts clearly support several decoration grammars at 8x8: compact graphics, horizontal stripes/bands, checker/plaid patterns, and placket/button layouts. These should be capacity-gated and source-grammar-driven.
nextStep: v8 should generate mixed vanilla-only variants by selecting only capabilities supported by the target garment and using these reviewed donor examples as grammar references, not literal copied pixels.
